item.title: Your smartwatch could soon be obsolete
item.description: Apple, Samsung, and Google are winding down updates for several popular smartwatch models. Here’s what owners need to know. End of life for tech devices is kind of a fuzzy line. While people on tight budgets, or those who don’t need the latest and greatest features, often use their smartphones, tablets, and watches until they no longer run, the companies behind those devices eventually stop supporting them, which can open the door for hackers....

item.title: Prediction markets let you bet on layoffs. Do the masses think your company is next?
item.description: Users on platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket bet whether many companies will cut head count. Experts say it’s a trend worth monitoring. Prediction markets let users bet on everything from sporting events to natural disasters and the outcomes of war. But they also set odds on layoffs and staff reductions at some of the largest companies, raising a question: If the market isn’t bullish on your company’s head count numbers for next quarter, should you start looking for a new job?...
